title: Packaged CLI may be omitted from published package
reasoning: The package advertises a bin entry at ./dist/cli.js and only publishes dist, but the manifest evidence only shows a plain TypeScript build. If the package tsconfig does not include packages/core/src/cli.ts or does not preserve the executable shebang in the emitted dist/cli.js, npm installs of @docgit/core will expose a broken docgit command. This is a release hazard for the claimed package-json-bin feature because the only executable contract is the packaged artifact, not the source file.
reproduction: Run `pnpm --filter @docgit/core build && test -f packages/core/dist/cli.js && head -n1 packages/core/dist/cli.js` before packing/publishing. A missing file or missing `#!/usr/bin/env node` line reproduces the broken bin package.
recommendation: Add an explicit packaging verification for the bin artifact, and ensure the build includes cli.ts with the shebang preserved. If needed, update the package tsconfig include list or add a postbuild check that fails when dist/cli.js is absent or non-executable as an npm bin.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests are provided for this feature, and the package scripts shown do not include a pack/bin smoke test.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a package-level smoke test that runs the build, packs or installs the package artifact, then invokes `docgit --version` from the generated bin.
minimumFixScope: packages/core build configuration or package-level release test for the CLI bin artifact.
